items.title: VST, CEG Stocks Drop As Election Outcome Hits Merchant Power Generators
items.summary: Incoming Texas governor Gina Hinojosa has advocated an immediate pause on new data-center construction, an end to related tax incentives, and stronger local controls over water and electricity use.

items.title: Vistra plunges 13.5% as Texas election rattles AI power trade, KeyBanc downgrades
items.summary: Investing.com -- Vistra shares plunged 13.5% on Wednesday after a sweeping Democratic victory in the US midterm elections raised concerns about the future of data-center development in Texas, prompting KeyBanc to downgrade the electricity generator.

items.title: Constellation Energy Sinks 8%, Vistra Down 14% as Democrats’ Midterm Sweep Hits AI Power Stocks
items.summary: Key TakeawaysConstellation Energy fell 8% this morning after Democrats won Congress, in a selloff that also hit Vistra, GE Vernova and CoreWeave. Its signed deals with Alphabet’s Google and Amazon still stand, so the risk is in future contracts.

items.title: GE Vernova Sinks 10%, Vistra Down 12% as Democrats Win Congress: “Incrementally More Negative Sentiment”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysGE Vernova fell 10% today, with Vistra and Constellation Energy, after Democrats won both chambers of Congress. Only about 20% of GE Vernova’s contracted gas turbine capacity serves data centers.

items.title: Vistra Set for Q3 Earnings Release: Is the Stock a Buy, Sell or Hold?
items.summary: VST expects strong Q3 earnings growth on robust power demand, hedging and higher capacity revenues, but is the stock worth buying ahead of results?

items.title: Vistra Sinks 10%, Constellation Down 6% as Democrats’ “Blue Tsunami” Hits AI Power Stocks
items.summary: Key TakeawaysVistra stock fell 10% today after Democrats won Congress and Texas, pulling Constellation Energy, GE Vernova and Vertiv down too. Texas Governor-elect Gina Hinojosa campaigned on a moratorium on new data centers.

items.title: GE Vernova Soars 6%, Eaton Up 7% on Record Orders and Bernstein’s Data Center Call
items.summary: Key TakeawaysGE Vernova shares rose 6% on Nov. 3 after Eaton’s record third-quarter orders and a bullish Bernstein note on data centers.

items.title: Vistra Gains 5% as Talen Guides 2027 EBITDA Up 26% on “Strong PJM Fundamentals”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysVistra gained 5% today after Talen Energy guided 2027 adjusted EBITDA about 26% higher on PJM demand. Constellation Energy rose on the same news, and GE Vernova and Vertiv rallied on their own.
